test_cases.name: Betty Botter Tongue Twister (Default Input)

input_files.input1.txt:
Betty Botter bought some butter
but the butter was bitter
Betty Botter bought some better butter
to make the bitter butter better

test_cases.expected_stdout:
word : better count : 2
word : betty count : 2
word : bitter count : 2
word : botter count : 2
word : bought count : 2
word : but count : 1
word : butter count : 4
word : make count : 1
word : some count : 2
word : the count : 2
word : to count : 1
word : was count : 1

test_cases.name: Case Insensitivity and Duplicate Counting

input_files.input1.txt:
Apple APPLE apple
Banana banana
oraNGe

test_cases.expected_stdout:
word : apple count : 3
word : banana count : 2
word : orange count : 1

test_cases.name: Shared Prefix Ordering in Trie

input_files.input1.txt:
trie tried trying try
trie try
tried

test_cases.expected_stdout:
word : trie count : 2
word : tried count : 2
word : try count : 2
